title: Imantat Yatiñan Sirviripa
intro: Qurán ukan sarnaqäwinakan jach’a tapicería ukanx mä enigmática figura ukaw sayt’atäski, Allah ukan sirviripaw divina yatiñampi khuyapayasiñamp k’achacht’ata. Aka jan amuyt’kay jaqix mä jach’a profetampiw thakhinak chiqancht’asiwayi, ukat mä thakhi saräwiruw puri, ukax jan amuyt’kay lurawinakamp phuqhantatänwa, ukax jaqinakan amuyt’awipan límites ukanakaruw ch’amanchawayi. Sapa luratanakajj jan cheqäkaspas ukhamäkchïnsa, destino, paciencia ukat Diosan kamachipan jan uñjkañ yatiñanakapat wali jachʼa yatichäwinak imantapjjäna. ¿Khitis uka chʼamaktʼir jaqejja, ukat kuna cheqa yatichäwinaksa uñachtʼayapjjäna?
clues: Nayax Allahan luqtiripätwa, wali yatiñataki ukat khuyapayasiñatak ajllitätwa.
Mä jachʼa profetajj nayat yateqañwa munäna, ukat nayajj wali chʼama condicionanakampiw iyaw sayäta.
Tantachäwijanxa kimsa luräwinakwa lurawayta, ukax masijatakix jan walïkaspas ukhamänwa.
Pobre jaqenakan botep jan waltʼayawayta, ukampis imantat khuyapayasiñaw utjäna.
Mä jiskʼa waynan jakäwip aptʼasiwayta, qhuru jaqëkaspas ukhamäkchïnsa, awk taykapar jan llakisiyañatakiw ukham lurasïna.
Mä markan mä perqa wasitat saytʼayawayta, uka perqajj janiw katoqtʼapkituti, ukat uka perqa manqhanjja mä tesoro ukaw uñstäna.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
